name: Screen Dialogue
description: Declarative preset for actable speech. Host application and screenplay generation are not implemented.
purpose: Write speech meant to be performed: short, actable, and free of novelistic interior caption.
writing_goals: Cut lines that only repeat the picture
Give actors an action in the line
constraints: Do not write novel interior as spoken text
Do not paste chapter dialogue unchanged
checklist: Plot facts that must be heard are heard once
